title: Ziyarat of Maytham al-Tammar
intro: The visitation of Maytham al-Tammar, a devoted companion of Imam Ali.
description: Read Ziyarat of Maytham al-Tammar with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أيُّهَا الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ يَا مَيثَمَ بِنَ يَحيَى التَمَّار
blocks.transliteration: alssalāmu `alayka ayyuhā al`abdu alssālihu ya maytham ibna yahya al-tammār
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allāh), O Maytham son of Yahya al-Tammār

blocks.arabic: المُطِيعُ لله وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِأَمِيرِ المُؤمِنِينَ وَلِفَاطِمَةَ وَالحَسَنِ وَالحُسَينِ(صَلَوَاتُ الله وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيهِم)
blocks.transliteration: almutee’u lillāhi wa lirasulihi wa li'amiri almu’minina wa li fāṭima walhasani walhusayni ṣalawātullahi wa salāmuhu `alayhim
blocks.english: who acted obediently for the sake of Allāh, His Messenger, the Commander of the Faithful, Fāṭima, al-Ḥasan, and Al-Ḥusayn, peace be upon them.

blocks.arabic: أشْهَدُ أنَّكَ قَدْ أقَمْتَ الصَّلاَةَ وَآتَيْتَ الزَّكَاةَ وَأمَرْتَ بِالمَْعْرُوفِ وَنَهَيْتَ عَنِ المُْنْكَرِ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad aqamta alssalāta wa ātayta alzzakāta wa amarta bilma`rufi wa nahayta `an almunkari
blocks.english: I bear witness that you performed the prayers, defrayed the poor-rate, enjoined the right, forbade the wrong,

blocks.arabic: وَجَاهَدْتَ فِي الله حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ وَعَمِلْتَ بِكِتَابِهِ مُقْتَدِيَاً بِالصَّالحِيِنَ وَمُتَّبِعَاً لِلنَبِيِّين
blocks.transliteration: wa jāhadta fi allāhi haqqa jihādihi wa `amilta bi kitābihi muqtadiyan bil ṣāliḥīn wa muttabi`an lil nabiyyīn
blocks.english: strove in the way of Allāh as it ought to be striven, and abided by His book, following in the footsteps of the pious ones and adhering (to the teachings) of the prophets

blocks.arabic: وأشْهَدُ أنَّكَ قُتِلْتَ مَظْلُوماً شَهِيدَاً فَلَعَنَ الله مَنْ ظَلَمَكَ وَمَنْ إِفَتَرَى عَلَيْكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka qutilta maẓlūman shahīdan fa la`anallahu man ẓalamaka wa man iftara `alaya
blocks.english: I bear witness that you were martyred unjustly, may Allāh curse those who oppressed you and accused you falsely

blocks.arabic: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ مَنْ نَصَبَ لَكَ العَدَاوَةَ وَالبَغْضَاءَ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ وَحَشَا اللهُ قُبُورَهَم نَارَاً وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابَاً أَلِيماً
blocks.transliteration: wa la`anallahu man nasaba lakal `adāwata bal baghdā’ ila yawmil qiyāma wa ḥasha quburahom nāran wa`a`dda lahom `athāban `alīma
blocks.english: May Allāh curse your enemies till the Day of Judgement and may He fill their graves with fire and prepare for them a painful punishment

blocks.arabic: جِئْتُكَ أَيُّهَا العَبْدُ الصَالِحُ زَائِرَاً قَبْرَكَ مُقِرَّاً بِحَقِّكَ مُعْتَرِفَاً بِفَضْلِكَ
blocks.transliteration: ji`tuka ayyuhal `abdul ṣāliḥu za`iran qabraka muqirran bi ḥaqqika mu`tarifan bi fadlik
blocks.english: I have come to you O’ pious servant, visiting your grave while recognising your right and adhering to your grace

blocks.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللهَ بِالشَأْنِ الذِي لَكَ عِنْدَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: as’alu allāha bilshsha’ni alladhi laka `indahu an yusalliya `alā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin
blocks.english: I ask Allāh in the name of the standing that you enjoy with Him to send his blessings upon Muḥammad and his family

blocks.arabic: وَأَنْ يَقْضِيَ حَوَائِجَنَا فِي الدُنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ وَيَجْمَعَنَا وَإِيَّاكُم فِي زُمْرَةِ الفَائِزِينَ مَعَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ الطَاهِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa an yaqdi ḥawa`ijana fil dunya wal `ākhira wa yajma`ana wa iyyakum fi zumrat alfa`izīn ma`muḥammadin wa `aalihi altāhirīn
blocks.english: and fulfil our needs in this world and the next, and unite us amongst the successful ones with Muḥammad and his purified household

blocks.arabic: وَاَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا الشَّهِيدُ وَرَحْمَةُ الله وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: wasalamu `alayka ayyuhal shahīdu wa raḥmatullahi wa barakatuh
blocks.english: Peace and blessings be upon you O martyr

blocks.text: You may then offer a two-unit prayer and present it as a gift to Maytham al-Tammār.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت میثم تمار کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
